en: Black‑and‑white historical photograph showing a formal procession in front of a monumental colonnaded building. In the foreground is an open horse‑drawn or motorized carriage with uniformed officers in long capes and peaked caps; one elderly man sits wrapped in a cloak. To the left a uniformed rider or motor officer passes close to the camera. Behind them, dense crowds of civilians and officials in early‑20th‑century dress stand on steps between tall classical columns; a period streetlamp rises at the right.
